name: Serra Angel
flavor: Every setback and every triumph had led to this: the moment when she played her last card and knew without a doubt she had won.

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: Other Merfolk get +1/+1 and have islandwalk. (They can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.)
flavor: "Ooh, a Tide Shaper! This is going straight into my Svyelun deck."

name: Zombie Master
text: Other Zombie creatures have swampwalk. (They can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.)\nOther Zombies have "{B}: Regenerate this permanent."
flavor: Not even the cold embrace of death could keep him from his Prerelease events.

name: Goblin King
text: Other Goblins get +1/+1 and have mountainwalk.
flavor: He stepped inside, then stared in awe. Never before had he imagined such joy and wonder could be contained all in one place.
rulings: [{'date': '2005-08-01', 'text': 'Goblin King now has the Goblin creature type and its ability has been reworded to affect *other* Goblins. This means that if two Goblin Kings are on the battlefield, each gives the other a bonus.'}]

name: Gaea's Liege
text: As long as Gaea's Liege isn't attacking, its power and toughness are each equal to the number of Forests you control. As long as Gaea's Liege is attacking, its power and toughness are each equal to the number of Forests defending player controls.\n{T}: Target land becomes a Forest until Gaea's Liege leaves the battlefield.
rulings: [{'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'When being declared as an attacker, use the “not attacking” power and toughness. It only changes after declaration is complete.'}, {'date': '2006-09-25', 'text': 'The activated ability doesn’t affect whether the land is basic or not. It overwrites any other land types. Being a Forest gives the affected land the ability “{T}: Add {G}.”'}, {'date': '2006-10-15', 'text': 'Will not add or remove the supertype snow to or from a land.'}]

name: Chaos Warp
text: The owner of target permanent shuffles it into their library, then reveals the top card of their library. If it's a permanent card, they put it onto the battlefield.
rulings: [{'date': '2011-09-22', 'text': 'A permanent card is a card with one or more of the following card types: artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker.'}, {'date': '2011-09-22', 'text': "If the permanent is an illegal target by the time Chaos Warp tries to resolve, it won't resolve and none of its effects will occur. No library will be shuffled and no card will be revealed."}, {'date': '2011-09-22', 'text': "If the revealed card is a permanent card but can't enter the battlefield (perhaps because it's an Aura with nothing to enchant), it remains on top of that library."}, {'date': '2011-09-22', 'text': 'If the revealed card is not a permanent card, it remains on top of that library.'}, {'date': '2011-09-22', 'text': "The owner of a token is the player under whose control the token was put onto the battlefield. If a token is shuffled into a player's library this way, that player shuffles before revealing the top card of that library."}]

name: Commander's Sphere
text: {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.\nSacrifice Commander's Sphere: Draw a card.
flavor: With the right tool, nothing is impossible.
rulings: [{'date': '2020-11-10', 'text': "If you don't have a commander, Commander's Sphere's first ability produces no mana."}, {'date': '2020-11-10', 'text': 'If you have two commanders, the ability adds one mana of any color in their combined color identities.'}, {'date': '2020-11-10', 'text': "If your commander is a card that has no colors in its color identity, Commander's Sphere's first ability produces no mana. It doesn't produce {C}."}]

name: Underworld Connections
text: Enchant land\nEnchanted land has "{T}, Pay 1 life: Draw a card."
flavor: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: {T}: Add {C}.\n{4}, {T}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.
rulings: [{'date': '2018-12-07', 'text': "Activating the second ability of Rogue's Passage after a creature has become blocked won't cause that creature to become unblocked."}]

name: Transmutation Font
text: {T}: Create your choice of a Blood token, a Clue token, or a Food token.\n{3}, {T}, Sacrifice three artifact tokens with different names: Search your library for an artifact card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.

name: Oltec Matterweaver
text: Whenever you cast a creature spell, choose one —\n• Create a 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature token.\n• Create a token that's a copy of target artifact token you control.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
flavor: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Costly Plunder
text: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.\nDraw two cards.
flavor: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.
rulings: [{'date': '2020-08-07', 'text': "You can't cast Costly Plunder without sacrificing a permanent, and you can't sacrifice additional permanents."}, {'date': '2020-08-07', 'text': "You can't sacrifice an artifact to generate mana to pay towards Costly Plunder's cost and also to pay its additional cost."}]
